results.reason_zh: 历史设置未统一视口：Chromium 宽度为 780，Moli 为 1920。Search 链接祖先含 d-lg-none，网页 CSS 在宽度达到 992 时隐藏该入口；桌面页面显示完整搜索框。因此后续 a[href="/search"]:visible 超时属于共享基准设置干扰，不能据此归因于 Moli 导航恢复。前一步快照的执行上下文销毁仍是独立记录的导航观测错误，不证明后续链接因导航而不可见。旧浏览器责任归因已被本修订替代；官方失败分数不变，须统一视口后重新资格验证完整轨迹集并全范围重跑。
results.reason_en: Historical viewport settings differed: Chromium was 780 pixels wide and Moli 1920. The Search link has a d-lg-none ancestor, which site CSS hides at widths of 992 or more; the desktop page shows the full search field. The later a[href="/search"]:visible timeout is therefore affected by shared benchmark settings and does not establish a Moli navigation-recovery defect. The preceding snapshot's destroyed execution context remains a separate navigation observation error; it does not establish why the later link was hidden. This revision supersedes the previous browser attribution without changing the official failure score. Requalify the full trajectory set and rerun the full scope at a common viewport.
